purpose: Registration #3785 / release #3072 / incident #4445: harden the independently authorized read-only dual-channel production SSH host-key attestation after review identified secret-output, protected-port and publisher-provenance defects in v1. No trust-anchor change or production mutation is authorized.
requiredBehavior: run only from exact owner command /production p0-ssh-host-attest-v2 current-main on incident authority #4445
require a non-empty protected PC_PROD_SSH_PORT and scan only canonical REG.RU IPv4 195.19.12.120 after DNS confirmation
require three byte-identical non-empty hosted ssh-keyscan observations before accepting an external public-key set
transport public host-key evidence between jobs only as short-lived workflow artifacts so a fingerprint equal to the protected stored pin is never used as a job output
run local attestation only on the pre-existing restricted self-hosted labels self-hosted, linux, x64, pc-prod and tai-readonly without repository secrets
verify non-root, no-docker runner boundary and attest only root-owned non-writable public /etc/ssh/ssh_host_*_key.pub files
require every externally observed algorithm/fingerprint pair to exist in the local production host-key authority
classify the protected stored pin only in the final hosted job and never transport or publish that pin
publish a replacement fingerprint only when the stored pin is independently proven mismatched; that candidate must differ from the stored pin
bind every channel to one exact current main SHA and publish PRODUCTION_MUTATION=NONE
forbiddenCapabilities: changing, deleting or automatically accepting PC_PROD_SSH_HOST_FINGERPRINT or any GitHub secret
StrictHostKeyChecking=no, accept-new, UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null, password SSH or any authenticated SSH session
reading SSH private host keys or production private keys
sudo, Docker mutation, systemctl mutation, service restart, deployment, migration or production filesystem mutation
database, customer-data, password-reset, mail-send, MFA, TOTP, session, role, tenant or reviewer mutation
publisher execution for non-owner, unrelated or malformed issue comments
new paid provider, SaaS subscription or recurring cost
unrelated PC-CROP business-flow, Gekta, Company OS or showroom behavior changes
acceptanceEvidence: workflow syntax and focused contract pass
three stable hosted public-key scans on the non-empty protected SSH port
restricted production runner proves external keys are a subset of local root-owned public host-key authority
final classifier reports PASS_EXISTING_PIN_VALID or PASS_ROTATION_REQUIRED without emitting the protected old pin
replacement candidate is published only for independently proven mismatch
result states PRODUCTION_MUTATION=NONE and does not count as registration or owner-access acceptance
